root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `buf[0] == '1'` after the overflow-carry repair branch executes.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `fallback_format()` reaches `if (buf[0] == overflow)`, it must repair the carried leading digit to `'1'` before returning so the later non-fixed trailing-zero cleanup does not erase the only digit.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original increments `exp10` but leaves the only stored digit as `'0'`, while the fixed original repairs that digit to `'1'` at the same carry site.

nodes.state: At the `copy_str()` call site, the constructed source range is reversed because `digits_ + 1` already points past `digits_ + num_digits_`, so the following sink consumes invalid bounds.
The non-fixed trailing-zero cleanup trims the only digit and resizes the buffer to `num_digits == 0`.

edges.relation: The leading digit written by the overflow-carry repair is the same last digit examined by the trailing-zero cleanup when only one digit remains in the buffer.
The zero-length digit count produced by trailing-zero cleanup is passed unchanged into `float_writer::prettify()` as `num_digits_`, which is then used to build the `copy_str()` source range.
